subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the plugin-facing attempt field remain a supported key-index alias, or should OpenClaw begin a defined deprecation and removal lifecycle now?
rationale: Repository policy requires maintainer intent and a named removal plan before deprecating shipped plugin SDK surface; code review cannot choose that compatibility promise.

options.title: Keep the alias supported
options.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, add the two explicit fields, and leave attempt as the stable backward-compatible key-index alias.

options.title: Approve a deprecation lifecycle
options.body: Keep the annotation only with an explicit migration window, removal target, documentation, and compatibility coverage approved by the API owner.

recommendation.title: Keep the alias supported
recommendation.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, add the two explicit fields, and leave attempt as the stable backward-compatible key-index alias.
